At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with institutional administration teams:

Institutional administration
  Delegated: Arrange appointments, verify credentials and exchange records within the institution’s access rules.
  Stays with you: Restricted access and consequential decisions require an authorised institutional owner.
  Exception: Two offices must confirm a change to a shared appointment.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.

See the institutional administration workflow: https://uieglobal.com/solutions/institutional-administration/?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t1-institutional
Discuss a pilot: https://uieglobal.com/?pilot=Institutional%20administration&utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t1-institutional

Is this something your team handles enough of to be worth a 20-minute conversation?
